subject: Television & Streaming
title: Will Streaming Last?
description: A micro-lesson that makes Will Streaming Last? usable.

hook.text: Every entertainment format that seemed permanent eventually fell. Radio, network TV, cable—all disrupted.

buildup.text: Streaming's weaknesses are emerging: rising prices, too much content, decision fatigue, and creative burnout.

discovery.text: New technologies loom. AI-generated content, interactive media, and virtual reality could reshape entertainment again.

twist.text: Young audiences already spend more time on YouTube and TikTok than on any streaming platform.

climax.text: Streaming won't disappear, but it may evolve into something unrecognizable—just as every medium before it did.

punchline.text: The only constant in entertainment is that nothing stays.

quiz.question: What trend threatens traditional streaming platforms among younger audiences?
options: Preference for short-form platforms like YouTube and TikTok
